phase: M0 real inputs + L2 production image loop + L3 estimator perturbation + M4 decision page
decision_question: Does mounting the 0907 Hybrid Carrier on the gripper instead of rig0818 support a >= 0.8 mm final TCP p95 gain on the recorded manipulation task?

inputs.cameras: inputs/cameras_0804_fisheye.json (7 calibrated Thor GMSL2 fisheye cameras, 1920x1080)
inputs.task: inputs/task_132514.json (bimanual 60 fps; dev episode 0, held-out episodes 1-2)
inputs.occluders: inputs/gripper_v2.json (URDF finger mechanism mesh, declared housing and hand envelopes; the other hand's gripper and hand too)

arms.R0: rig0818: measured 0818b layout (five DICT_6X6_50 markers, 60.4-60.8 mm, CAD frame) on 69.6 mm pads with declared black bracket rods; production ArUco detector + production corner BA
arms.H0: 0907 carrier image, anchors only; production corner BA over the carrier's exported marker layout
arms.H1: the same 0907 images; production HybridCarrierTracker seeded from the previous joint pose + carrier_frame_pose (corner BA then facet refinement, 12 mm limit)

mounts.gripper: both targets seat their CAD socket on the same stud over the housing, lowest point 5 mm clear; yaw {0,90,180,270} x boom tilt {0,-25} deg searched per arm on dev episode 0 (max coverage, then min raw p95) and frozen before held-out rendering
mounts.socket_tcp: control: each target keeps its dev-chosen gripper yaw and tilt (dome up) and only its CAD socket origin moves onto the TCP point; no own gripper. Before 2026-09-11 the control took the URDF TCP axes (TCP z = -y of the box), which laid both targets on their side

real_input_image_loop.mechanism: the same accepted per-frame poses re-read at the anchor centroid, the rig origin (socket), a common arm (R0's centroid->TCP length along each target's own direction) and the TCP label; plus the 2026-09-09 bench statistics computed on simulated poses (slow-hand 1 s cubic noise floor, facet refinement step, cameras decoding per frame)
real_input_image_loop.rendering: subpixel fisheye rays (4x supersample, convergence checked against 8x), exact triangle depth with per-triangle projected-box culling, metric ArUco textures and facet ink, 3-sample exposure integration over the recorded twist, 0.4 px blur, 1 DN noise
real_input_image_loop.truth_vs_estimator: images are rendered from truth; each L3 session perturbs only what the solver is told (camera K and pose, marker layout, body scale, marker->TCP bundle, label time), with one draw shared by all arms

levels.evidence: measured or scenario sigmas from noise_sources.json

outputs.smoothed: production offline SE(3) smoother over each hand x episode (the dataset label)

real_input_image_loop.statistics: all requested frames in every denominator; paired dp95 = p95(R0) - p95(H1) on common-success frames; 95% interval from a bootstrap that resamples sessions and 2 s time blocks; inverted-CDF quantiles for point and interval

decision.CONDITIONAL_GO: primary scenario (gripper, evidence, smoothed): lower bound >= 0.8 mm, H1 p95 <= 3 mm, rotation p95 <= 0.5 deg, coverage > 99% and not below R0, catastrophic rate not above R0, no fast/occluded bucket with the interval entirely below zero
decision.NO_GO: upper bound of the primary interval < 0.8 mm
decision.formal: the formal decision equals the numeric one only when every blocking G0 check is closed; the page recomputes it from the numbers and ignores decision strings in the file

synthetic_sandbox.kernel: simulator-core.js (M0/M1/MC-lite in the browser, synthetic seven-camera rig and trajectory)
synthetic_sandbox.role: interactive sensitivity only; never part of the decision

non_claims: A simulated pass is not physical accuracy certification; independent GT and a real paired A/B remain required.
rig0818 marker geometry is the measured 0818b layout; the bracket between its pads is still drawn as declared rods, and a fresh remount would need its own layout.
The BOX housing, hand envelope and both gripper mounts are declared assumptions.
Truth is a smoothed 0812-cube trajectory used as a task-distribution proxy; it is not the ground truth of the 132514 demonstration.
